verification.playwright: 15 routes × 360/390/768/1349: zero overflow, heading, label or console issues; lab import round trip and draft restore verified; tab panels switch by click and arrow keys; sub-nav anchors land below the sticky bars.

changes: Hardware imagery: eight original shaded vector portraits (DGX Spark, MS-S1 MAX, Mac Studio, RTX 5090, DXP4800 Plus, 990 PRO, Stream Deck +, PodMic USB) drawn from published dimensions, used on the home page, storefront picks, explorer cards and decision pages; captions say 'Original illustration · not a photograph'. Vendor photographs were ruled out: Apple and Samsung press terms exclude promotional/commercial reuse and the vendor hosts are unreachable from the build environment, so no licence could be verified.

Live lab on /shop: the real Source-to-Brief Lab replaces the static artifact preview in the free-lab section, framed and labelled live; its chunk loads only when the section nears the viewport so storefront performance is unchanged.

Embeddable product cards at /shop/embed/[slug] (edition and free lab): self-contained HTML, no script, frame-ancestors *, noindex, 5-minute cache; links target the parent window; checkout state comes from the same resolver so a card can never show Checkout while the storefront hides it. Each product page shows the live card in an iframe beside a copy-ready snippet.
Machine-readable catalogue at /api/shop/catalog (starlight.shop.catalog/v1) with price basis, availability mode and relationship labels; CORS open; no stock or reviews because none are verified.

Availability list storage: requests are written as one private JSON object each to a Vercel Blob store when BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN is linked, and/or forwarded to the https endpoint; 202 only when a sink accepted; 503 with the email fallback when none is configured. Operator export (JSON/CSV, dedupe by email+product, CSV formula-escaped) behind a ≥24-char SHOP_ADMIN_TOKEN compared in constant time. Privacy page names the store, region (fra1), retention and deletion contact.
notShipped: The Blob store itself: creating it needs the Vercel dashboard (Storage → Blob → private, fra1) and project linking; the API refused store creation from this session (403). Until linked the form stays on the fail-closed email path.
Any vendor photograph or model-accurate render.
